target-mutation.note: Secondary/gatekeeper/solvent-front mutations in the drug target (EGFR T790M/C797S, BCR-ABL1 T315I, ALK G1202R, BTK C481S, ESR1, AR-V7).

bypass/parallel-pathway.note: A parallel RTK/effector reactivates downstream signaling around the blocked node (MET/HER2 amplification, RAS/PI3K, CDK2/CCNE1).

feedback-reactivation.note: Blocking one node relieves feedback and reactivates the pathway (BRAF->EGFR in colon, MEK->RTK, adaptive upregulation).

pathway-redundancy.note: Multiple parallel routes to the same phenotype make single-node blockade insufficient (integrins, angiogenic ligands, lymphocyte homing).

pharmacologic/efflux-metabolism.note: Drug efflux (P-gp/ABCB1, MRP, BCRP) or altered uptake/metabolism reduces intracellular exposure.

DNA-repair/apoptosis-evasion.note: Enhanced DNA-damage repair or blocked apoptosis (ERCC1/HR, BRCA reversion, DNA-PK/ATM, TP53/BCL2 family).

antigen-escape.note: Loss/downregulation of the targeted antigen or its presentation (CD19 loss, EGFRvIII loss, BCMA loss, B2M/HLA loss).

TME/immune-exclusion.note: A cold, T-cell-excluded or immunosuppressive microenvironment (low TMB, MDSC/TAM, WNT/beta-catenin, PTEN loss, desmoplasia, hypoxia).

lineage-plasticity/transformation.note: Cells switch identity to escape target dependence (adeno-to-SCLC, neuroendocrine prostate, B-ALL to myeloid lineage switch).

correlate-not-driver.note: Target/biomarker robustly associated with disease but NOT the causal dependency (IGF-1R, IDO1, MET-IHC, Hedgehog in CRC). BiRAGAS flags these as correlates, not drivers.

on-mechanism-toxicity.note: An on-target/on-mechanism SAFETY liability, not a tumor-intrinsic escape program (paradoxical MAPK SCC, cardiac/CNS off-tumor T-cell attack, checkpoint autoimmunity).

combination-no-rationale.note: Agents combined on additive hope with no synergy (IDO1+PD-1, checkpoint+chemo unselected). A trial-design failure, not a tumor gene program.

population-dilution.note: Right drug, wrong (unenriched) population; responders averaged away below the endpoint threshold. A statistical/enrollment failure with NO tumor-intrinsic gene signature.
